insight.headline: Partner apps must enable bulk operations before use
insight.what_changed: Starting today, apps need access to bulk operations before they can run bulk queries or bulk mutations with the GraphQL Admin API. You can enable access for your app in the Partner Dashboard. What changed Bulk queries and bulk mutations are enabled separately: To run bulkOperationRunQuery, your app needs access to bulk queries.
